title: Studies
purpose: Find a study and see which consent basis governs the specimens of its collections.
summary: Studies and the consent basis that governs the specimens of their collections.

tasks.title: Record a study
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New study]], then link the collections it governs.

tasks.title: Find a study
steps: Type a code, title, investigator or ethics reference in [[Search]], or choose [[Status]] or [[Consent basis]].

good_to_know: A collection is governed by at most one study at a time.
Material of a suspended or closed study cannot be distributed.
Ethics approved until is shown only. Nothing is blocked when it passes.

sections.title: What a study is
paragraphs: A study records the ethics approval and the consent basis under which specimens of its linked collections may be distributed. A collection is governed by at most one study at a time. Specimens whose collection is not linked to an active study cannot be allocated, picked, packed or dispatched.

items.label: Study
items.description: The study code; opens the study.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, Suspended or Closed. Material of a suspended or closed study cannot be distributed.

items.label: Consent basis
items.description: Consent records (each participant's recorded consent governs) or Study-level determination (a committee's determination covers the study; recorded refusals still block).

items.label: Ethics approved until
items.description: Shown only; nothing is blocked when it passes.

items.label: Consents
items.description: Consent records of the study; the number opens the consent list filtered to the study.

items.label: Search
items.description: Code, title, principal investigator or ethics reference.

items.label: Search, filters, Apply, Clear all
items.description: Search and the filters narrow the rows on the server; Apply runs them and Clear all removes every filter and the search. Active filters show as chips you can remove one by one. An invalid filter shows an error and no rows rather than everything.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Shows or hides columns for you; the first column stays.

items.label: Sorting and paging
items.description: Click a sortable heading to sort; click again to reverse. Rows per page: 25, 50 or 100. The count under the table is the number of rows matching the filters.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows matching the current filters and sort as UTF-8 CSV (up to 10,000 rows; a larger selection is refused, narrow the filters). Cells a spreadsheet would read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe. Each export is recorded with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

sections.title: Actions and access
paragraphs: Every staff role (admin, manager, technician, viewer) can open this page. Only admin and manager see and can use the buttons that change records; the server refuses the change to anyone else.
New study (admin and manager) opens the study form. With no studies the page says so and offers New study to those who may create one.
